title: Kimi moves up to K2.5
summary:
Kimi got a K2.5 upgrade, error handling became more honest, and the secret-rotation machinery got a needed tune-up.

The Kimi text model was upgraded to K2.5 through Fireworks AI, bringing the newer model into the unified text endpoint.

Bad image fetches now return a clear 400 response rather than a generic server error, while klein-large concurrency was tuned down to avoid memory crashes under load.

Enter tokens were rotated and a hardcoded-token exposure was cleaned up; the rotation script now updates the corresponding Modal secret too. Security maintenance: unglamorous, effective, ideally boring.
